name: Belastingdienst IB47 Aanlevering
description: Belastingdienst IB47 yearly batch submission source. Accepts the IB47 XML payload (per the Belastingdienst XML schema 2026) rendered by the IB47 docudesk template. Every successful submission triggers an audit-trail event recording the submission hash and HTTP response status per REQ-DPA-006 and ADR-022. Credentials managed by openconnector — no app-local IB47 HTTP client.
